text: The account holder is Tariq Naveed with account number PK**MUCB****6560, opened on 30 December 2020. The subject is a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 220,000 per month. During the activity window from 2 June 2026 to 25 June 2026, there were 14 credits totalling PKR 19,311,000 and 4 debits totalling PKR 14,618,000. The account received 13 cash deposits totalling PKR 19,091,000 at four branches: Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch. The activity was flagged by Tazama on 25 June 2026, with a typology score of 320 against a threshold of 300. Nine of the 13 cash deposits (69%) were between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, just below the reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000, consistent with structuring indicators. Credits in the activity window were 87.8 times the declared monthly income of PKR 220,000 per month, suggesting cash volume inconsistent with declared income. The pattern of repeated cash deposits just below the threshold, spread across multiple branches, and the high cash volume relative to declared income are indicative of suspected structuring. PKR 7,825,000 was sent to Crescent Imports (PK**CRES****1592, Synthetic Bank C) in 2 transactions. PKR 6,793,000 was sent to Sheraz Traders (PK**SHER****1518, Synthetic Bank A) in 2 transactions. Debits equal 76% of credits and occurred with a median of 28.4 hours between the latest credit and each debit. No match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening was found on 28 June 2026. Account placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision; no contact was made with the customer about this review.
